record_scope_reconstruction: Bagayeros disrupted the Pocitos/Yacuiba–Salvador Mazza international road bridge in July 2023, on the Argentine side according to the July 4 report. Freight and personal passage were affected; reopening traffic flowed both ways. This is one road crossing, not the nearby railway or the whole Bolivia–Argentina border.

source_checks.finding: July 4 report inspected: second day of blockade, Argentine-side bagayeros and customs demands, effects on commerce and persons.
July 6 report inspected: blockade lifted around 19:00 following customs negotiations, trucks then passed in both directions; report says Monday start and three days, canonical dates retained.
